notes: Version 3 (#437): Club's handling band 0.35-0.75 (0.2-0.7 in version 2), as every boat steers by hand on skiff@7 (the default class). Placeholders (#102, #443, #437), for the owner to tune: each tier's skill band (her tactics), its handling band (how well she steers by hand, drawn apart from her skill; the bands overlap so a sharp tactician can have a sloppy helm and the reverse), its share of a Mixed fleet's bots (weights, here in proportion to the skill bands' widths, so a Mixed fleet's skills spread evenly over 0.35...1), and the mean-place gap each tier step must keep over mixed fleets (BotTierSuiteTests).
